fixed: "Circle L", "Larks pull by L", "Slice L", "Larks pass R shoulder", "Neighbor alle R 1.5" and "Zig L, Zag R", as Caller's Companion writes them, now come in as the figure with its direction, hand or shoulder instead of text, and "R&L" as a right and left through. This applies to imports and to figures you type, and Re-check custom figures picks it up for dances already imported. A lone L or R anywhere else, such as in a note about who stands where, stays as written.

changed: The shared recognizer spells a bare l/r as left/right straight after circle, pull by, pass, slide, slice or allemande; reads "alle" as allemande; and reads "R&L" (also "R & L" and "R&L thru") as right and left through. The ContraDB dialect's zig-zag reader takes a bare L/R as the side.
